### How to Live the Bible — More Than Words
Author: Mel Lawrenz
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2021/08/how-to-live-the-bible-more-than-words/
Passage: 1 John 1:1-3
Points:
- Faith in Jesus is grounded in tangible, firsthand witness rather than empty words.
- The message of the Word of Life began with Christ and was carried on by eyewitness apostles.
- The gospel proclamation has spread across centuries to millions around the world.
- Believers are urged to examine whether they have truly accepted this life-changing message.
- Christians are called to actively proclaim Christ in daily life through encouraging speech and tangible actions.
